rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physical location offshore, such as an offshore rig.

example.english: The drilling rig is offshore, far from the coast.
example.traditional: 嗰座鑽油台喺外海，離岸好遠。
example.jyutping: go2 zo6 zyun3 jau4 toi1 hai2 ngoi6 hoi2 lei4 ngon6 hou2 jyun5

rows.note: Use this for an offshore business or financial arrangement, especially one involving tax or labour-cost advantages.

example.english: The company moved part of its business to an offshore jurisdiction to reduce tax costs.
example.traditional: 呢間公司將部分業務搬去離岸地區，以減低稅務成本。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zoeng1 bou6 fan6 jip6 mou6 bun1 heoi3 lei4 ngon6 dei6 keoi1 ji5 gaam2 dai1 seoi3 mou6 sing4 bun2

rows.note: Use this when something is moving in the direction of the open sea, rather than describing where it is located.

example.jyutping: sau2 syun4 maan6 maan2 hoeng3 ngoi6 hoi2 sai2 heoi3
